stories.summary: Swing History Enhancements: View, Edit, and Delete

details.user_story: As a user, I want to view, edit, and delete my swing history so that I can manage my swing library effectively and add context to help me remember each swing.
details.context:
Currently, users can see a list of their swings in the Profile screen, but:
- Tapping a swing only shows an alert with basic info
- Swing filenames are random strings (e.g., 'video_1234567890.mp4')
- Users cannot add notes or rename swings
- Users cannot delete old swings
- Users cannot view the full analysis with video playback from history

This makes it difficult to organize and find specific swings.
acceptance_criteria: User can tap a swing in history to view full analysis with video playback
User can add/edit a custom title or notes for each swing
User can delete a swing from their history
Swing list shows custom title (if set) instead of filename
Video playback from history shows skeletal overlay and bat trail
Delete action requires confirmation to prevent accidental deletion
Editing swing details updates the database
UI provides visual feedback during loading/saving
technical_details: - Add 'title' VARCHAR(255) column to swings table (nullable)
- Add 'notes' TEXT column to swings table (nullable)
- Create migration script for new columns
- Add PATCH /api/swings/{swing_id} endpoint to update title/notes
- Add DELETE /api/swings/{swing_id} endpoint to delete swing
- Ensure DELETE cascades to analysis_results (already configured)
- Display skeletal overlay and bat trail
- Show attack angle and other metrics
- Add modal/screen to edit title and notes
- Update local state after successful save
- Remove from local state after successful delete
- Display swing.title if set, otherwise swing.filename
- Add subtitle showing notes preview (first 50 chars)
- Pass swing data and analysis as route params
- Support back navigation to Profile screen
edge_cases: User deletes swing while viewing it: Navigate back to Profile after delete
Network error during save: Show error message, keep local changes
Network error during delete: Show error message, don't remove from list
Video URL is invalid/expired: Show error message with option to re-upload
Analysis data is missing: Show message 'Analysis not available'
User edits title to empty string: Use filename as fallback
Very long title/notes: Truncate in list view, show full in detail view
Concurrent edits from multiple devices: Last write wins (acceptable for MVP)
User navigates away while video is loading: Cancel video load
